verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the founder's HN comment that Shortwave's Gmail API integration enables "offline handling". That is a first-party claim of some offline capability, but it says nothing about what works offline or how changes sync back. No official docs or hands-on reports describe offline behavior. Missing for 10: documented offline reading of cached mail, offline search, offline composing/queued sending, sync-on-reconnect behavior and conflict handling, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can read, search, and write email offline, with changes syncing when I reconnect

citations.quote: We integrate with Gmail's APIs (not IMAP) to enable faster real-time updates, better latency compensation, offline handling
